reviews.review:
It is a decent and cool game, but I don't recommend it. The set up for all of the levels is just down right stupid. The "military", make the tactical decision to deploy your squad in the middle of enemy territory, surrounded, and they usually know you are already there, for pretty much every single level. With decisions that are supposedly made by the military on how to approach every level, you have to ask yourself, "How in the hell is this the dominant species on the planet?". Best part is, the enemy has god tier accuracy, similar to the jackals in Halo 2 on Legendary; have fun getting sniped by an enemy that is so far away you can't see them because he is literally on the other side of the map. Also, the characters seem woefully unbalanced. The air raider is useless without someone playing with you, his vehicles tend to get destroyed very quickly since they are all slow moving.
Spoilers: level 100 has you facing off against multiple 15 story monsters in an open field. I had to take a break because the screen shakes constantly no matter how far or close you are, I got sea sick playing the game; ffs.

I also played EDF 4.1. Number 5 has many improvements to the gameplay and mechanics; it does seem they tried.

I have now finished the game. The mission I described earlier is not the end mission. I have since taken to trying the game on Hardest mode, after beating hard mode. I am at mission 33 with 63 hours in. Apparently, the developers recommend your armor be around 3k or 5k. I am 1.6K with 63 hours. Holy hell, what ungodly creature felt it was appropriate to add a farm requirement for armor to play this game. Going from Hard to Hardest, the only thing that could come close to killing you was a boss, at best they could get half your health. Introducing the golden ant, no idea what his damage threshold is, but he is a common enemy that makes his first appearance on Hardest Mode, that can one shot you. I hate this game at this point. I was happier with it on my first play through on hard. The expectation that I keep replaying different difficulties to get armor is horse hockey. I still think this is a cool game, but the mechanics are just stupid.

EDF!! Just listening to the banter of your fellow soldiers is funny as hell. This is a metal song embodied by a video game. Or is it a video game embodied by a metal song? I'm just surprised (disappointed) there's no real metal in the soundtrack. Put on some Iced Earth or Soilwork, turn down the in-game music, and blast away! No better feeling.

Expect cheesy dialog, over-the-top voice acting and some ludicrous comparisons, but the gameplay itself is highly engaging.  

NOT for arachnophobes, but it does nearly loving tribute to some of the classic giant monster movie tropes.  

The blasting of giant bugs, robots, and multiple varieties of giant humanoids, as well as other targets is a treat, and you'll want to make sure you have a good, hard hitting long range weapon in your gear.
